Commentary.Commentary: Once again it was a brilliant start by the Kiwi opening bowlers. Matt Henry and Trent Boult set the early tone but the back-up bowlers didn't manage to create the same kind of impact. Henry with a 4-fer was the most successful bowler while Boult once again impressed with a 3-wicket haul. The pitch has a little bit of spice in it and the Indian new-ball bowlers would like to use that to their advantage. Do join us in a short while for the chase.

Great recovery from India! They were struggling at 18/4 at one stage but then Shankar and Rayudu revived the innings with a 98-run stand. The former was unfortunate to get run out after a mix-up but the latter continued and added yet another useful stand with Kedar Jadhav. Rayudu missed out on his century and New Zealand bounced back towards the end by picking wickets at regular intervals. But Hardik Pandya's 22-ball 45 cameo helped India cross the 250-run mark.

OUT! Run out! Full and on middle, Chahal pushes it back and Shami comes out of the crease in search of a run. Boult collects the ball and runs at his end to break the stumps. Shami has no way back. India are all out for 252!
Yuzvendra Chahal is the new batsman. He was the top-scorer in the last ODI for India. Has two balls here to do something.

OUT! Well caught by Ross Taylor! A fuller length delivery on off, Bhuvneshwar reaches out for it with the intention to go over covers. Hits it well but not well enough to take it over Taylor at the edge of the circle. Rosco goes down to grab it safely.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Shami rotates his bat across the line and inside edges it down to fine leg for one.
Too full and outside off, Kumar hangs back and drives it through covers for a run.
Full and around off, Kumar swings it across the line off the inner half and it rolls in front of square leg. They take a couple.
Mohammed Shami is in next.

OUT! It is a legal delivery and Pandya has to walk back. He is dismissed off a full toss. Also a lot of credit has to be given to Boult as he has taken an absolute blinder. A full toss on the pads, Pandya swings but ends up getting a top edge in the square leg region. Boult at short fine leg runs towards the ball and takes it by stretching forward. Neesham, however, is asking him to throw it back as there is a doubt of it being a no ball. Boult does exactly that as the batters complete two. The umpire though has not signaled one as of now but Pandya is seen standing his ground. The umpires now come together and take it upstairs. Replays show the delivery is below waist height. End of a brilliant cameo by Pandya. He has provided the much-needed impetus to the innings.
What happened there? Hardik Pandya is caught brilliantly by Trent Boult but the umpire wants to check for the waist high full toss. Is it dipping in?

FOUR! Feel bad for the bowler there, that delivery did not deserve to go to the boundary. A yorker on off, Pandya manages to jam it out past the fielder at short third man and into the fence. 15 from the over with a ball to go. Can he end it with a bang?

Good cricket all around! A brilliant yorker on off, Pandya jams it out towards mid-wicket. Calls two straightaway. Completes one, drops his bat at that end, goes for the second and completes that too. However, the replays later on show that Pandya did not ground any part inside the crease and it has been signaled as one short.

Good change in length and pace. Slower short ball, Pandya does not play a shot thinking it is a wide. The umpire though feels differently. Pandya is not happy and rightly so. The replays show that it went over his head.
SIX! Help yourself! A gift there for Pandya, a full toss on the pads. Pandya shuffles across and then whips it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 10 from the first two balls.
FOUR! What a shot and what a start to the over! Pressure right on the bowler. He lands it full and outside off, Pandya creams it through covers and it races away.
James Neesham to bowl the 49th.
Eases a full ball down to long off and keeps strike with himself. 10 from the over, 28 in the last two.

SIX! How has he pulled that one? Was in no position. Boult digs in a short ball, angling into the batsman, Hardik jumps on the back foot, loses his balance a bit but still nails his pull shot over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Slower in pace, on a length and outside off, Kumar opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single.
On a length and outside off, Hardik forces it down to long off and takes a single.
Pitches it up and around off, Pandya pushes it towards extra cover, denies the run.
Hits the yorker mark outside off, Kumar deflects it down to third man for a run.
Trent Boult is back on.
Another leave to a delivery outside off. Two dots to end a very expensive over here. 18 from it.
Faster delivery and outside off, just inside the tramline. Pandya leaves it alone. Thinking it is a wide but not signaled and rightly so.
SIX! That's enormous! Three in a row! He just loves spinners. A leg spinner landing around leg, Pandya clears his front leg, sits down on one knee and smokes it over cow corner.

SIX! How has that gone all the way? Surely that has to be due to the quality of the bat. This is tossed up outside off, it is a little too full. Pandya looks to go over covers but ends up slicing it. He hits it high in the air, it is in the gap in the cover region and it goes over the fence.
SIX! That should get Pandya going! Slightly short and Hardik makes the bowler pay the price. Rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Flatter and outside off, Pandya is guilty of going too hard at it, ends up getting it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Around off on a length, it's pushed from the back foot to point. Dot ball to end his spell. Brilliant bowling by Henry, finishes with figures of 10-1-35-4!
Shortish and outside off, Hardik goes hard at it and mistimes his back foot punch to the right of the point fielder. A single is taken.
A slower one around off, cutting away probably, Kumar plays inside the line and runs it down to third man for a run. Bhuvi is off the mark!
Good length ball around off, Kumar stays back and taps it down to point.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is the new batsman.

OUT! Plays it on! Soft dismissal that! The slower one on off, Jadhav at first looks to dab it down to third man but then seeing the line he tries to work it on the leg side. Is done in by the lack of pace, gets an inside edge onto his pads and then onto the stumps. Henry gets his fourth and all four have been crucial wickets. This one also as the Kiwis are now into the lower-order. 250 looks a touch farfetched. All depends on Pandya now.
Width on offer outside off, slashed through covers for a run by Pandya.

FOUR! Spoils the over just a little bit, still a good one though. Just 5 from the 45th. Another tossed up ball outside off, Jadhav lofts it over cover-point, beats the dive of the fielder in the deep and finds the fence. Also 200 up, 5 more overs to. 250? Possible but they will have to go all guns blazing.
Another top delivery! A yorker outside off, Jadhav jams it out towards covers.
Make that just a run from the first 4 balls as Astle tosses it up outside off, Jadhav looks to sweep but misses.
On the shorter side outside off, it is punched through covers for a run. So just a run from the first three balls.
Two dots in a row as this is fired on the stumps, Pandya strokes it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, it is eased down to mid off.

Just a run from the Free Hit! That was a really well played shot though from Pandya. An overpitched delivery outside off, it's stroked over covers and the fielder in the deep collects it on one bounce. 11 runs and a wicket from it!
A high full toss on off, Jadhav deflects it past the point fielder for a run. Called a no ball for being above the waist. Free Hit coming.
FOUR! That's some shot with mid off up inside the ring. Henry pitches it up and outside off, Kedar packs a punch and drills it down the ground for a boundary. No stopping this one.
Nearly edges it to the keeper. Short and outside off, a late thought by Kedar to flirt with it. Swings his bat but fails to connect.
A touch short and on off, Jadhav stays back and defends it down safely.
Hardik Pandya arrives. The stage is set for his kind of batting. Will he deliver?

OUT! Henry strikes! He has the last laugh. No ton for Ambati Rayudu and he walks back in disgust. The slower one outside off by Henry. It is on a fuller length so Rayudu looks to go over covers. But his bat turns in his hands and he ends up slicing it towards the man in the deep. Munro there runs forward and takes a neat catch. An excellent knock from Rayudu comes to an end. He though will be disappointed as he misses out on a well-deserved ton. Another timely wicket for the Kiwis and that too of the set batsman. They have also put a full stop to the partnership which was becoming dangerous.

FOUR! Just not learning here is Henry. He once again goes short and pays the price. Rayudu gets on top of the bounce and pulls it all along the ground and into the backward square leg fence. Into the 90s.
Shortish again outside off, Jadhav tries to run it down but finds the short third man fielder. Terrific over, just 2 from it.
A little short and wide outside off, Rayudu goes on the back foot and slaps it in front of square on the off side for one.
Play and a miss! A touch short and outside off, Ambati tries to cut but misses.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended back from the crease.
Misses out! Short and wide outside off, Rayudu plays the square cut but finds the fielder inside the ring.
A full toss on off, Jadhav hits it firmly back past his partner at the other end for a run at long on.

FOUR! A clever shot that but the fielder should have prevented the boundary. Rayudu maybe expecting the full ball, he brings out his innovation and goes for the reverse sweep. Manages to hit it fine past the keeper on the off side. Colin de Grandhomme at third man runs to his left, slides but ends up parrying it into the fence. Perfect end to the over for the Indians. Another good one for them as 10 comes from it.
Shortish again, this one is pulled to fine leg for a run.
A bumper and a good one, Jadhav looks to pull but misses. He wants it to be signaled a wide but the umpire does not oblige.
Got away there did Henry! A full toss outside off, Rayudu maybe guilty of going too hard at it. Gets an outside edge and it goes down to third man for a run.

FOUR! It is in the gap! Excellent shot. Not a great delivery knowing that the short boundaries are the square ones. Short and on middle, Rayudu pulls it in the gap in the square leg region and a boundary results.
Bowls it very full and on off, Rayudu strokes it to covers.
Matt Henry is back into the attack.
Half-tracker outside off, Kedar cuts it in front of square on the off side, the point fielder misfields slightly and they cross.
Flatter and fuller on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Short again, this time outside off, Kedar cracks it to deep cover where Santner makes a diving stop. Fumbles a bit but then recovers before it touches the rope. Another couple added.
Drops his length short on middle, Jadhav moves back and pulls it to wide long on. Henry in the deep does well near the rope to save two for his team.
Once again Kedar gets on the front foot in defense.
Full and flighted on off, Jadhav defends it off his front foot.
Powerplay 3 begins. New Zealand can now have an extra player outside the ring, five to be precise. Todd Astle is back on.

SIX! Second in the over! Top over for India, 15 from it. Once again it is the slog sweep which gives Rayudu a maximum. It is right off the middle again, this one though has more height than the last one but also the distance. 50-run stand comes up!
Remains 9 with a ball to go as this one is pushed to the man at covers.
SIX! He has picked the bones out of that one! Brings out the slog sweep, hits it right off the meat and it sails over the mid-wicket stand. 9 from the over till now, 2 balls to go.
Slower ball and outside off, Rayudu there had no pace to play with. He finds the man at cover-point with his cut.
Now works it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Nicely chipped! Full and around off, Jadhav lofts it over covers and takes two.
Short and outside off, Kedar ramps it down to third man and collects a single.
Tickles a full ball on middle through square leg and returns for the second run.
150 comes up for India with a wide! Short and down the leg side from 'round the wicket angle, an easy leave for the batsman. A good stop by the keeper. Trent was seen tumbling in his followthrough.
Rayudu walks down the track again, takes it on the full this time and forces it out towards extra cover for a single.
Picks the short ball early and pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Advances down the track to a full ball around off and drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

DROPPED BY BOULT! Full and angling into the batsman, Rayudu tries to clear long on but fails to get enough meat behind his shot. Boult rushes forward from long on, tries to catch it with a dive but spills it. Ambati gets a reprieve. They cross for a run to end the over.
Wicket to wicket line, Jadhav nicely wrists it through backward square leg and runs the first run hard. Wants the second but Rayudu turns it down.
Fullish and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Uses his wrists to flick a length ball but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Munro with his pace is on the shorter side outside off and it's asking for trouble. Rayudu camps back and whacks it through backward point.
Good length ball on middle, Rayudu pushes it out from the back foot. The mid-wicket fielder moves forward to collect the ball.
Slower one to finish with. Fullish around off, Kedar is on the front foot in defense.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Called a wide! Boult tries to reply back with a bouncer but it's down the leg side.
FOUR! Crunched! One bounce into the boundary. Jadhav hangs on the back foot, fetches a shortish ball from around off and thumps his pull shot over mid-wicket.
Tests the batsman with a bouncer, Kedar ducks.
Stays back and punches a length delivery to covers.
Around off on a length, Rayudu pushes it towards point for one.
Trent Boult returns.
Another delivery is played down to the man at third man. Rayudu will retain strike for the next over.
Jadhav now plays it with an angled bat down to third man and changes strike.
Now Rayudu guides it to third man and gets to the other end.
On middle, defended.
Nicely played! Waits for it and then guides it through short third man for a single.
A little too straight on middle, it is worked to square leg.
Drinks break.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Brings up his fifty in style and what a time to score one, his team was in dire straits at 18 for 4 but he rose to the occasion, weathered the storm early on and now is getting into his own. He needs to continue though. His 10th fifty in ODIs. Coming to the ball now. Rayudu again uses his feet, it is bowled on his hips, he pulls it once again and this one races to the square leg fence. Two boundaries to end the over, the second better than the first. A good one for India as 9 comes from it.

FOUR! The wicket has fallen but India will continue to look for the boundaries. Rayudu dances down the track, Colin is smart enough to bang it short. Rayudu is smarter as he pulls it all along the ground, through backward square leg for a boundary.
Very slow and short, Jadhav waits for it and then looks to cut but is foxed by the pace. Latham behind fails to collect and concedes a bye.
Jadhav steps down the track once again and also makes room. Colin though follows him, Jadhav mistimes it to mid on.
Uses his feet to cover the swing, Colin bowls it shorter and KJ defends it to point.
BEATEN! Nicely bowled! Length ball and it shapes away. Jadhav is drawn into playing a shot. He tries to defend but gets beaten.
On the shorter side, Rayudu cuts it but finds the man at point. He must be disappointed there, it was asking to be hit but AR could not find the gap.
Good length and on off, Rayudu pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and on the hip, Jadhav helps it towards fine leg for a single.
On off, kept out.
Up and over! Clever shot this! It is fuller and on middle, Jadhav lofts it over mid on. Boult gives it a chase and manages to pull it back before the ball crosses the ropes. Two saved by him.
On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length just around off, this time Jadhav turns it in the gap at mid-wicket and rushes to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it to covers.
A touch short and outside off, Kedar remains back and taps it down to point.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it on the leg side.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Jadhav sticks back and offers an angled bat in defense.
A length ball around off, blocked from the crease.
Colin de Grandhomme is back on.
Angles in a good length ball on off, Rayudu pushes it from the back foot to mid-wicket.

OUT! RUN OUT! The last thing India would have wanted. That is probably the only way this 98-run stand could have been broken. Timely for New Zealand as the two were looking to up the ante now. Also, they will be delighted to see the back of Shankar as he was really playing well. A huge mix-up has brought about his downfall. Munro lands it on middle, Vijay pushes it towards mid on and wants a run. He sets off but then seeing Ambati Rayudu ball-watching, he stops. In the meantime, the fielder from short mid-wicket runs after the ball. Rayudu realizes late that Shankar wants a run and then goes for it. Shankar though had started returning towards his crease, after seeing Rayudu run towards him, he goes for the single. But it was too late. Yes, Neesham did miss his shy at the bowler's end but Munro collected the ball and then underarms it onto the stumps at his end. Shankar walks back dejected and India now have half their side back in the hut.
Kedar Jadhav's turn to bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single.
On the stumps, defended.
A little too short, Shankar goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
On middle, Rayudu pushes it towards mid off for a single.
The length is a bit short around off and Ambati punches it wide of the diving point fielder for one.
Floated and full on middle, a little bit of drift, Rayudu pushes it back to the bowler.
Fullish and on off, driven down the ground to long off for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. No run.
Shout for an lbw! A muted one in fact. A slider landing full on middle, Shankar draws forward but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Well played! Shankar picks the length very early. It's slightly short and he rocks back to smash it through point. Scampers back for the second run.
Todd Astle is brought into the attack.
A dot to end! So just that maximum from the over. Full and wide outside off, Rayudu throws his bat at it but gets beaten.
Good length on off, Rayudu keeps it out.

SIX! All the way! Releases all the pressure that was building in this over. Rayudu uses his feet and gets it in his arc. He swings, connects well, it goes high up in the air and over the mid-wicket fence.
On off, Rayudu waits for it and then guides it to point.
A little too straight, Rayudu looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Continues bowling it on a length, Rayudu mistimes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Santner is on the shorter side with his length. Shankar gets deep inside the crease and cracks it through point. 100 up for India!
Serves this one slower through the air and lands it a touch short, Rayudu gets back and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Fuller and on middle, pushed back and the bowler parried it to covers.
Floated and full on off, Rayudu lunges and opens the face of his bat to push it towards point.
Gets forward and drives it past the diving cover fielder for a run.
Flatter and shorter outside off, hit to sweeper cover for a run.
A little short on off, Rayudu clips it towards mid-wicket and sets off. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Would not have made a difference though had he hit. Rayudu was well in.
Length again outside off, Rayudu finds the man at cover-point once again, no run this time.
Wicket to wicket line, Vijay gets back and pushes it down to long on for a run.

Risky run! The dive has saved him there. This is played straight towards cover-point and Rayudu wants a run. Shankar too goes for it. The fielder picks the ball up and fires it to the keeper who collects it and whips the bails off but the batsman has made it in.
On the stumps, the batsman once again defends it nicely.
Cramps the batsman for room by bowling it on his body, Rayudu pushes it to covers.

Plays this one with soft hands to covers and pinches a single. 5 runs in the last two, quiet going. India now cross their total of the last game. It has taken them 27 overs to do so and 4 wickets too.
Strides forward and drives it off the outer half of his bat to backward point.
Flatter and on middle, forced down off the back foot to long on for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball around off, Rayudu plays the reverse sweep wide of short third man for a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it down through mid off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length again on off, blocked.
Good length on middle, it is kept out.
This is eased down to long on for a run.
Good length around off, it is guided to point.
Length on off, Shankar pushes it to covers.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Shankar gets back and punches it down to long on for one. 7 from Santner's first over.
Rayudu has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.

Good stop, Taylor! A loopy one, full and outside off, Rayudu tries to loft it over covers after advancing down the track but it spins away and catches the outside half of his bat. Flies over backward point and Taylor from short third man gives the chase. Pulls it back near the fence and they take two.
Goes back to a short ball and punches it through covers for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Rayudu strides forward to drive but it takes the inside edge and goes through his legs behind square leg. A single taken again.
Flighted ball, too full and on off, Shankar drives it past the diving cover fielder for a run.
Mitchell Santner has been inserted into the attack.
A little too straight, it is clipped to fine leg for a run. Just three from Munro's over.
Some extra bounce there. On a length and around off, Shankar does really well to defend it.
Nicely done! Taps it towards covers and gets to the other end quickly.
Rayudu now works it with the angle towards mid-wicket. Does not find the gap though.
This time he closes the face at the right time and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Leading edge! Angles it into the batter, Shankar looks to turn it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat a little too early. He gets a safe leading edge to point.

SIX! This is what he tried in de Grandhomme's previous over but missed. Has nailed it this time. Looks good when they come off. A touch short and around middle, Rayudu wears his skates to run down the track and towers it over the bowler's head for a maximum. 8 from the over, 15 in the last two.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Good length delivery sliding down the leg side, Ambati neatly deflects it off his pads to fine leg for a boundary.
Rayudu dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Good length ball around off, Rayudu punches it to cover-point. No run.
A touch short and outside off, Shankar runs it down to third man for a run. 50-run stand comes up. A sensible one but they need to carry on.
Good length ball angling in around off, Vijay presents a straight bat in defense.
A dot to end as the last ball is guided to the point fielder.
On off, Rayudu guides it to point.
On the fuller side, Shankar times it towards mid on and takes a single. Boult there misfields but no extra run conceded.
Gets a single this time as it is worked towards deep square leg.
Rayudu needs another sighter against the new bowler as he defends it towards covers.
Length delivery on off, Rayudu keeps it out.
Colin Munro is on now. He bowls dibbly-dobblies. The keeper is up to the stumps.
Quietly turns it off his pads to square leg and retains strike with a run.
What was that? Rush of blood for Rayudu. He wants to dominate de Grandhomme. Jumps out of the crease and swings his bat blindly across the line. No connection made. Colin gives him a stare.
Another leg bye as this time Vijay fails to work a length ball off his pads.
Angling down the leg side, Rayudu fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. They collect a leg bye.
Width on offer outside off, Vijay glides it to third man for a run.

FOUR! Streaky one! Colin gets a short delivery to jump onto the batsman. Shankar is taken aback, tries to fend at it but misses. It goes off his helmet and runs behind for a boundary. Given as runs by the umpire.
Really good running! End of a good over for India. Shankar taps this length delivery towards point and gets to the other end.
On off, it has been defended.
Shortish and outside off, Rayudu guides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Pulled and pulled nicely! Short and on the body, it sits up to be hit. Rayudu swivels and pulls it through backward square leg and into the fence.

BEATEN! He could have so easily left that. Rayudu just did not need to play at that one. Length outside off, Ambati plays a nothing shot. He chases it away from his body but gets beaten. Neesham appeals but he is only one doing so.
Once again Neesham bowls it on the pads, Shankar works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. James has been poor here, he has been too straight.
Lovely delivery to end! That swings away from middle and it swings quite a long way. Beats the outside edge of Rayudu's bat as he tries to defend.
Good length and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Uses his feet but Colin spots it. He shortens his length, the batsman guides it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Close! Good length and outside off, Rayudu looks to guide it down to third man but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good timing! It won't go all the way but the batsmen get two. On middle, Rayudu strokes it on the up through mid on and takes a brace. 50 up for India, it has taken around 19 overs to come.
Angling in from around off, solidly blocked off the front foot to end the over.
FOUR! Shankar seems to be very strong on his pads. Neesham bowls a cross-seamer, it's full and on the pads, Vijay leans across and flicks it behind square leg for a glorious boundary.
Gently pushes a length delivery on the off side and steals a single.
False shot! Neesham tempts Rayudu with a wide one outside off. Ambati spots the chance to free his arms, throws his bat at it but fails to make any connection. Almost nicked it behind!
Dishes out a length delivery just outside off, Rayudu presses forward to cover the line and then makes a leave.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Rayudu sticks on the back foot and punches it to cover-point.
Back to bowling length on off, Shankar pushes it to mid off. 4 continuous dots to end.
Sees Shankar stepping down and de Grandhomme bangs it short. Vijay though manages to block it onto the ground.
Length again around off, Shankar gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Corrects his line and bowls it on off, Shankar lunges and pushes it to covers.
Once again the line is a little too straight, Shankar works it through mid-wicket and takes two.
A little too straight, it is clipped around the corner for a single.

Drinks! 40/4 and there ain't much to say! It was the repeat telecast of the last ODI as the Indian top half faltered against moving balls. Shankar and Rayudu are trying to revive the innings and are amidst a 22-run stand. India will hope that this pair continues for as long as possible. For the Kiwis, they just need to maintain the same intensity in the middle overs and keep chipping away at the wickets.
A touch short and outside off, Vijay makes another leave. 9 came from Jimmy's first over but just 1 from this one. A good comeback by him.
Better line and length. It's just around off, Shankar reaches out for it and pushes it with an angled bat to covers.
Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Shankar covers the line and shoulders arms.

Gets away with a really bad delivery. Full and sliding down the leg side, Rayudu flicks it aerially over square leg and the fielder in the deep moves across to his left to make the stop. They pick up a single.
On a length and outside off, Rayudu takes a stride forward and eases it to mid off.
Too full and on middle, Rayudu brings down a straight back and pushes it to mid on.

Gets this one to jag back in after pitching. Shankar takes a few steps down the track and tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad. Just a couple from Colin's first. Good start from him.
Closer to the off pole this time but not close enough to make the batsman play.
A little too wide outside off, it is left alone.
Colin goes fuller this time, there is some outswing for him, not the same amount of movement he was getting in the last game though. Shankar strokes it to covers.
Rayudu now does the same thing! He pushes it to mid on and gets to the other end.
On the off pole, Shankar walks down the pitch and then pushes it towards mid on for a quick run.
Double change! Colin de Gradhomme comes into the attack.
Lands it on a good length outside off, Rayudu stays back to guard his stumps and then lets it through.
Neesham is yet to hit a good line and length. This one is full and on middle, Vijay clips it in front of square leg and takes a run.
A nice confident back foot punch through covers and once again Shankar comes back for the second run.

A soft outside edge. Fullish and on off, Shankar gets forward to push at it with gentle hands. It takes the outside edge and speeds past first slip. The third man fielder cuts it off and they take a couple.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Four leg byes! Neesham bowls a gentle loosener, it's full and angling down the leg side. Shankar fails to flick but it clips his pads and runs wide of the diving keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
James Neesham is on now.
Right on the money to end the over! On middle, Rayudu who is happy to block everything bowled at him, does so again.
EDGY RUN! Length and on off, it straightens a touch after pitching. Shankar looks to defend but it goes off the outer half towards third man for a run.
A much more solid shot this time but for no runs. Short and on off, Shankar pushes it to covers.
Loose that from VS! Just ahead of a shorter length outside off, Shankar goes after it away from his body and gets beaten.
Continues bowling it on a length and on the stumps, Shankar gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
On the off pole, Shankar blocks it to covers.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it solidly near his front pad.
On and around off, a length delivery, Vijay opens the face of his bat and runs it down to third man for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR BYES! Well left by Shankar. A 143.5 kph shorter one around off, Shankar leans back at the last moment and drops his wrists to allow it through. It just keeps on shooting off the surface and Latham has no chance of collecting it, even with a jump. Bonus runs for India.
Alters his length this time and goes full on middle, Shankar clips it off his pads to mid-wicket. Mixing his lengths nicely.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, whizzing off the surface at 144 kph, Shankar pushes tamely inside the line and misses. Latham collects it near his face. Nice carry.
Slightly outside off, Rayudu shoulders arms to it. A maiden from Henry. His first of the game.
On the stumps again and it is on a length. Rayudu this time is solid in defense.
Good change in length there! Goes short and it is well-directed. Rayudu is caught by surprise, he though does well to take one hand off the handle and block it onto the ground.
Once again bowls it at the top of off, Rayudu defends it pretty late.
Just a little wide outside off, a confident leave by Rayudu.
This one is angled into the batsman, Rayudu blocks it out.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Shankar chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

FOUR! This will give him immense confidence. A good length ball on middle, Shankar doesn't commit himself too much forward and just uses his wrists to work it past the diving short mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
That one stays low! Length delivery outside off, Shankar looks to push it through the off side off the back foot. He though is beaten by the low bounce.
Vijay Shankar strides out to the middle.

OUT! Death rattle! MS Dhoni is on his way back to the pavilion and it's a body blow to India. Beaten for pace and movement. An inswinger around off at 143 kph, Dhoni maybe tried to take his pads away from the line and then block it. But his willow comes down late. The ball sneaks past his defense and breaks the stumps and a million of Indian hearts.
Good pace. At 142 kph, Boult takes a length delivery away from the batsman, MSD watches it go safely into Latham's gloves.
Appeal from the bowler! Nothing from the umpire. Dhoni tries to flick a length ball but misses. He is hit on the pads but maybe that pitched outside leg.
Back of a length ball on off, Ambati is on the back foot in defense.
On a length and just outside off, Rayudu takes a stride forward to cover his stumps and then shoulders arms.
Full length ball on middle and off, pushed down to mid on.
Dhoni has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Fullish and on off, Dhoni gets forward and helps it off the inner half of his bat to mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Yes, it is going down with the angle. New Zealand lose their only review and that too pretty early. It always looked like it was going to miss the leg stump. Henry bowls the in-dipper this time but it starts from around middle and off. Dhoni looks to push it but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. Matt Henry convinces his captain to go for the review and Williamson does so. Replays roll in and they show no inside edge but Hawk Eye shows the on-field call is the right one. This review seemed like it was taken more in desperation of getting Dhoni early on.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW ha been turned down. MS Dhoni is the man in question. It looks like it will be going down with the angle.
This is a tempting line from Boult. Puts it on a driving length outside off, Rayudu does well to not fall for it. Covers his sticks and lets it through. A maiden.
Angling across the batsman, on a good length, this one takes off a bit after hitting the deck. Ambati has nothing to do with it.
Bowling a tight line here, Boult. Serves it on a good length around middle and off, Rayudu stays rooted inside the crease and blocks it to the off side.
A touch short and on middle, Rayudu goes on his toes and taps it down to square leg.
Keeps it very full and on off, Rayudu pushes it out off the front foot to covers.
Good length delivery angling away from the batsman, Rayudu covers his stumps and allows it through.
Who will bat next? MS Dhoni it is. India missed him in the last match. He can provide that solidity in the middle under tough conditions.

OUT! In the air... gone! Henry gets another and once again the Kiwis are all over the Indians. Henry lands it just behind a driving length outside off and this one too shapes away just a little. Gill looks to drive it on the up but is a touch early into the shot, maybe because the ball came slow off the surface. Also, he ends up playing the delivery away from his body. It does not hit the middle and lobs towards short cover. Santner there takes a good low catch. Another poor outing for the youngster and just like the last ODI, India are three down for nothing much on the board.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortens his length and lands it on off, Gill defends it.
FOUR! Wow! Top class! A shot that any batsman would be proud of. Full and on middle, Gill gets his bat down in time and hits it right off the middle through mid on. Need not run for those.

Close! Nicely played in the end! Very similar length to the one which got Rohit. This one also moves away a little. Rayudu adjusts, plays it with the movement as he opens the face at the very end and guides it down to third man for a run.
Hits the length hard around off, Rayudu shuffles across and keeps it out.
Fine stop, Kane. Too full in length on off, Gill drills his drive down the ground and Williamson at mid off makes a fine diving stop.
Ambati Rayudu is the new man in.

OUT! Gone! Boult strikes with a short ball. One apiece for the Kiwi opening bowlers now. It's outside off, Dhawan tries to play the upper cut probably but it flies in the air towards third man where the fielder is quite square and catches the ball safely. Matt Henry never looked like dropping that one. Both the openers once again back in the hut without doing much damage.
This time Boult hurls in a good length delivery in the zone outside off. Some shape there. Dhawan watchfully allows it to go to the keeper.
Fuller in length and close to off stump, Dhawan strides forward and defends it solidly.
Goes short first up to Gill. The young man stands back and pulls it easily behind square leg for a single.
Angles in a full ball around off, Dhawan brings his bat down and pushes it in the gap at extra cover for a quick single.
Another one middled but does not find the gap! Slightly fuller in length, the batsman lunges and strokes it on the up to the fielder at mid off. End of a successful over for the Kiwis.
The 4th one too has been hit well! Outside off, Gill plays it to point with an open face of the bat.
On the off pole, Gill stands tall and guides it to point. The first three deliveries he has faced, all have been off the middle. Should give him good confidence.
Off the mark is Gill. On the shorter side, Shubman stands tall and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Overpitches around off, Gill drives it from the middle of the bat towards extra cover. That will make the new batsman feel good.
Shubman Gill walks in next at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! What a ripper to get rid of the Indian captain. He though can be blamed for the lack of foot movement but take nothing away from the delivery. Henry goes fuller this time, it starts around middle and then begins to shape away late. Rohit with his feet rooted to the crease, looks to put bat on ball. He ends up playing inside the line, the ball whizzes past the outside edge and hits the off pole. Big wicket this and New Zealand strike early. Just the start they would have wanted. Back-to-back failures for Sharma.
Beaten this time. Some away movement from a length outside off at 144 kph. Dhawan feels for it and gets beaten. That wasn't far away from the outside edge.
Pitches it up and on off, Dhawan pushes it softly to the off side. Finds the cover fielder.
A touch short and around off, not enough room to work with, Dhawan goes on the back foot and defends it back.
Gets his line right there. Lands it on a length close to off stump, Dhawan gets behind it and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
FOUR! Boult errs in his line. Serves it down the leg side and Dhawan easily nudges it to fine leg for a boundary. First of the match!
Boult vs Dhawan now!
Inside edge! A full length ball outside off, Rohit gets forward to push at it but it takes the inner half of his blade and runs through backward square leg for one.
End of another tight over by Henry! Three good overs to begin with by the Kiwis. Length again around off, Dhawan defends it to point.
Extra bounce there! Length delivery on middle, it rises after pitching. Hits the higher portion of Dhawan's bat as he tries to defend.
On the pads, first real loose delivery. Rohit though fails to put it away as he misses the flick. The ball hits his pads and rolls on the leg side. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Just behind a driving length and on the stumps, Rohit blocks it out.
Good single! Dhawan was quick to take off there. He plays this with soft hands towards mid off and scampers across for a run. He is underway.
A gentle delivery outside off, Dhawan, since it was his first ball, shoulders arms.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out safely on the leg side. Tidy start from Boult, a maiden.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, an easy leave this time for Rohit.
Angling across the batsman, on a good length. Rohit plays it out from the crease to the off side.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Boult lands it on a length around leg, Rohit tries working it around but misses. He is hit on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Two noises there. Kane Williamson doesn't get convinced by his bowler. No DRS taken. Replays show that it hit Rohit first on the front pad and then on the back pad. Clipping the top of leg stump, the replays show later on.
Oohh...beaten all ends up! Movement there. Curling back in off the seam from a length around off. Sharma is forward in defense but it shapes back in to beat the inside edge.
Starts his spell by putting in a length ball in the line outside off, not much movement. Rohit watches the line closely before making a leave.
Trent Boult to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. He was the tormentor-in-chief in the previous game and would love to produce something similar again.

A single to end and India are off the mark! Could have been a lot more had it not been a good effort by Nicholls. Slightly short and there is width on offer outside off, Rohit stands tall and slashes at it. It goes to the left of the fielder at point. The fielder there dives to his stronger side and makes a half-stop. The man from third man mops it up. A single taken. Good tight over to begin with by Henry, however, not a lot of movement for him. He did not get a lot in the last game as well though.

JAFFA! Not a lot you can do with that. It is angled into the batsman at first. Rohit has to play at it, he tries to defend with minimal foot movement. The ball though pitches, moves away, beats the outside edge and goes agonizingly close past the off pole.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the stumps, Rohit once again is solid in defense.
A little bit of away movement there but the line is a little too wide outside off, Rohit need not play at those, especially so early.
Goes fuller, giving the ball a little more opportunity to do its bit. It goes straight on though and Rohit pushes it towards mid on.
Right on the money to begin with, no swing on the first ball though. Good length and on off, Rohit gets right behind the line and keeps it out.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Indian openers, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan make their way out to the middle. Matt Henry has the first new ball in hand and he will be bowling to the Indian skipper. Two slips in place. Here we go...

Pitch report - Sunil Gavaskar and Scott Styris standing near the playing area inform that the boundaries on the sides are shorter than the straighter ones so the teams will probably bowl fuller than shorter. Scott mentions the grass on the pitch has been trimmed a little and he reckons that it looks a good one to bat on as there should be medium bounce on this surface. Ends by saying there won't be a lot of swing here and hence, the wicket should suit the batters.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson, says they were looking to bowl first and make use of the early moisture. Informs they have made just a single change as the injured Guptill misses out and Munro comes in. Further adds that he is not sure whether the ball would swing here or not but it generally does at the start. Ends by saying that it is difficult to predict what a good score will be, so they will try to limit India as much as they can.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma, says it looks a good pitch, there is some moisture on it but they want to test themselves. He hopes to put up a good show after a humiliating loss in the last game. Informs they have three changes as Dhoni, Shami and Shankar come in for Karthik, Khaleel and Kuldeep. Mentions they did not have a lot of time after the first game but they will have to read the conditions better and learn from their mistakes. Further adds that had they got close to 200, the story might just have been different in the last ODI. Reckons the average total here is around 240 but if they bat well, they can get close to 300. Ends by saying that they need to assess the conditions and then take it on from there.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Rohit Sharma. India elect to bat first.

Last ODI of the series and it's a dead rubber but still there is plenty to play for. India will be eyeing revenge for their humiliating loss in Hamilton while New Zealand will be looking for a 3-2 scoreline which looks way better than 4-1. Hello and welcome everyone for the coverage of the fifth match of the series in Wellington. Two changes look certain at the moment, one is Martin Guptill missing out and other is MS Dhoni returning. Who will come in, who will go out? Stay tuned for the toss to find out...
